title: Province Abbreviations
synopsis: Have you ever wondered where the abbreviations for China’s provinces come from?

fullText.simplified:
省份简称

    为什么广东菜要叫粤菜，广东话要叫粤语？这里的“粤”是什么意思？上海市车牌上有“沪A”、“沪B”，这里的“沪”是什么意思？不知道你是否有过这样的疑问。
    “粤”是广东省的简称，“沪”是上海市的简称，这些都是省份简称。中国有23个省，5个自治区、4个直辖市、2个特别行政区，它们都有各自的简称。比如，吉林省的简称是“吉”，北京市的简称是“京”，广西壮族自治区的简称是“桂”，香港特别行政区的简称是“港”……
    一部分省份的简称就是取这个省份名字中的一个字。比如黑龙江省的简称是“黑”；天津市的简称是“津”。一部分省份的简称和历史有关。比如我们前面说的广东省，在古代被称为“百越（粤）地”，所以广东省的简称就是“粤”；上海市一带在古时候被称为“扈渎”，后来又改“扈”为“沪”，所以上海市的简称就是“沪”。还有一部分省份的简称和地理因素有关。比如湖南省有湘江，所以湖南省的简称就是“湘”；赣江贯穿整个江西省，所以江西省的简称是“赣”……大部分省份的简称只有一个，有个别省份有两个简称，比如四川省的简称是“川”或者“蜀”；云南省的简称是“云”或者“滇”。
    是不是特别难记呢？没关系，这里有个顺口溜，可以帮助你记住这些省份的简称：
京津沪渝直辖市，蒙宁新藏桂自治，
一国两制台港澳，东北三省黑吉辽，
冀晋鲁归华北，苏浙皖赣在华东，
湘鄂豫归华中，华南还有粤闽琼，
川滇黔归西南，西北还有陕甘青。
fullText.traditional:
省份簡稱

    為什麼廣東菜要叫粵菜，廣東話要叫粵語？這裡的“粵”是什麼意思？上海市車牌上有“滬A”、“滬B”，這裡的“滬”是什麼意思？不知道你是否有過這樣的疑問。
    “粵”是廣東省的簡稱，“滬”是上海市的簡稱，這些都是省份簡稱。中國有23個省，5個自治區、4個直轄市、2個特別行政區，它們都有各自的簡稱。比如，吉林省的簡稱是“吉”，北京市的簡稱是“京”，廣西壯族自治區的簡稱是“桂”，香港特別行政區的簡稱是“港”……
    一部分省份的簡稱就是取這個省份名字中的一個字。比如黑龍江省的簡稱是“黑”；天津市的簡稱是“津”。一部分省份的簡稱和歷史有關。比如我們前面說的廣東省，在古代被稱為“百越（粵）地”，所以廣東省的簡稱就是“粵”；上海市一帶在古時候被稱為“扈瀆”，後來又改“扈”為“滬”，所以上海市的簡稱就是“滬”。還有一部分省份的簡稱和地理因素有關。比如湖南省有湘江，所以湖南省的簡稱就是“湘”；贛江貫穿整個江西省，所以江西省的簡稱是“贛”……大部分省份的簡稱只有一個，有個別省份有兩個簡稱，比如四川省的簡稱是“川”或者“蜀”；雲南省的簡稱是“雲”或者“滇”。
    是不是特別難記呢？沒關係，這裡有個順口溜，可以幫助你記住這些省份的簡稱：
京津滬渝直轄市，蒙寧新藏桂自治，
一國兩制台港澳，東北三省黑吉遼，
冀晉魯歸華北，蘇浙皖贛在華東，
湘鄂豫歸華中，華南還有粵閩瓊，
川滇黔歸西南，西北還有陝甘青。

sentences.pinyin: tiān jīn shì de jiǎn chēng shì jīn

sentences.english: Some province abbreviations are historical.

sentences.simplified: 所以广东省的简称就是“粤”；
sentences.traditional: 所以廣東省的簡稱就是“粵”；
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ guǎng dōng shěng de jiǎn chēng jiù shì yuè

sentences.english: So Guangdong province’s abbreviation is “Yue”.

sentences.traditional: 所以上海市的簡稱就是“滬”。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ shàng hǎi shì de jiǎn chēng jiù shì hù
sentences.english: The Shanghai city region was called “Hu Du” in ancient times, and “Hu 扈” was later changed into “Hu 滬”.

sentences.traditional: 還有一部分省份的簡稱和地理因素有關。

sentences.english: Therefore, Shanghai’s abbreviation is “Hu”.

sentences.english: For example, Hunan province has the Xiangjiang river, so Hunan province’s abbreviation is “Xiang”.

sentence_translations: Province Abbreviations
Why is Cantonese food called “Yue cai”, and the Cantonese language “Yue yu”?
What does this “Yue” mean?
On Shanghai city car license plates we can see “Hu A” and “Hu B”. What does this “Hu” mean?
I don’t know if you have ever wondered about this.
“Yue” is the abbreviation for the Guangdong province, and “Hu” is the abbreviation for Shanghai city.
These are both province abbreviations.
China has 23 provinces, 5 autonomous regions, 4 directly governed cities and 2 special administrative regions.
They all have their own abbreviations.
For example, the abbreviation for Jilin is “Ji”. The abbreviation for Beijing city is “Jing”.
The abbreviation for Guangxi Zhuang autonomous region is “Gui”.
The abbreviation for Hong Kong special administrative region is “Gang”.
Some provinces are abbreviated by taking one of the characters from the province name.
For example, Heilongjiang’s abbreviation is “Hei”.
Tianjin city’s abbreviation is “Jin”.
Some province abbreviations are historical.
For example, Guangdong province, which we mentioned above, was called “Baiyue Di” in ancient times.
So Guangdong province’s abbreviation is “Yue”.
The Shanghai city region was called “Hu Du” in ancient times, and “Hu 扈” was later changed into “Hu 滬”.
Therefore, Shanghai’s abbreviation is “Hu”.
There are also some province abbreviations which are related to geographical factors.
For example, Hunan province has the Xiangjiang river, so Hunan province’s abbreviation is “Xiang”.
The Gan river run’s through the entire Jiangxi province, so Jiangxi province's abbreviation is “Gan”…
Most provinces only have one abbreviation, but a few provinces have two.
For example, Sichuan province’s abbreviation is “Chuan” or “Shu”.
Yunnan province’s abbreviation is “Yun” or “Dian”.
Isn’t it really hard to remember?
That’s alright. Here is a rhyme that can help you remember these province abbreviations:
Jing, Jin, Hu, Yu are directly governed cities. Meng, Ning, Xin, Zang, Gui are autonomous.
One country, two systems: Tai, Gang, Ao. Northeast’s three provinces: Hei, Ji, Liao.
Ji, Jin, Lu belong to North China. Su, Zhe, Wan, Gan belong to East China.
Xiang, E, Yu belong to Central China. Southern China also has Yue, Min, Qiong.
Chuan, Dian, Qian belong to Southwest China. Northwest also has Shan, Gan, Qing.
